newsitem.title: POLAND: OTC and bourse listing for Poland's Polisa opposed.
newsitem.headline: OTC and bourse listing for Poland's Polisa opposed.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse's president said on Friday that the bourse would move to prevent insurer Polisa SA from gaining an exchange listing if the firm were listed on the nascent over-the-counter market, PAP news agency reported.

"If Polisa shares are approved for trade on the OTC market then the Warsaw bourse's board will move so that they not be approved for trade on the stock exchange," PAP quoted Wieslaw Rozlucki as saying on Friday.
He said the firm's listing on and off-bourse would lower its turnover on both markets. @
Polisa shares have been approved for public trade by the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) but they have yet to receive bourse approval.
Polisa is also the only firm to have applied to the Centralna Tabela Ofert (CeTO) OTC market company for a listing. The OTC market itself, to be known as CTO, expects to start trade later this month.
On Thursday Polish Securities Commission head Jacek Socha said he did not oppose a listing on both markets and that he would strive so that firms themselves would decide.
